name: calling-crm
description: Multi-tenant cloud calling CRM for real estate teams (NestJS + Next.js + PostgreSQL + Redis + Plivo).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run build -w @crm/api && npm run build -w @crm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @crm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crm/api && npm run typecheck -w @crm/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crm/shared && npm run test:unit -w @crm/api && npm run test:int -w @crm/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @crm/shared && npm run test:unit -w @crm/api
